newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Tessenderlo to buy U.S. frame maker.
newsitem.headline: Tessenderlo to buy U.S. frame maker.

text.p: Belgian chemicals firm Tesenderlo said on Monday it had signed an agreement to take over Chelsea Building Products, based in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, from Chelsea Industries.
It gave no financial details of the deal.
Chelsea Building Products is a market leader in plastic profiles for windows and doors, with 300 staff and an annual turnover of $60 million, Tessenderlo said in a statement.
Tessenderlo said its plastics transformation division already had turnover of $60 million in profiles.
The Belgian company added that following this latest deal more than a tenth of the group's production would come from the United States.
